2027-04-01.title: God’s Plan Does Not Change
2027-04-01.verse: He answered, “Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator ,
2027-04-01.observation: In modern times, there are those who think of God’s Word as changing or adapting to the times. There are some who think that God’s Word develops with the cultures or with what they call “social progress.” However, this is not true. It is impossible to improve on what is already inerrant. If culture and God’s Word do not agree, it is culture that must bow its knee to the Creator of the world. This happens in every generation. One generation swings to the left and the other swings to the right. It is God’s Word that keeps everything tethered to the unchanging will of God.
2027-04-01.application: Go to God’s Word, not the winds of culture, for daily life instruction.
2027-04-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being solid and never changing.

2027-04-02.title: Serve Like the King
2027-04-02.verse: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
2027-04-02.observation: Do you want to be like the King? Serve. Do you want to be great among your peers? Serve. Do you want to make a difference? Serve. The King of all kings came to serve us all by taking our place in payment for salvation. Do we want to walk in the steps of our King? Serve others.
2027-04-02.application: Find a way to meet a need today.
2027-04-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the example to live by.

2027-04-03.title: Proper Service
2027-04-03.verse: And he said to them, “It is written, ‘’ but you are turning it into !
2027-04-03.observation: Jesus was not mad because they were selling things at “church.” The people coming to worship were from all over the known world. They would not be able to provide a spotless lamb or other offerings without being able to buy them. However, He was objecting to gouging the people and exploiting their need. We must be careful not to do the same. The Church should not be in the business of gouging people. It is okay to charge for expenses to provide a service. It is not okay to “sell” worship. The subtle and not so subtle difference shown here can be found in many areas of life. It all comes down to motive and abusing a good thing. What are some other areas where you can see this wisdom is needed?
2027-04-03.application: Is there another area of your life where you need to apply the wisdom of balance?
2027-04-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing us the difference in many areas of life.

2027-04-04.title: Who Is My Neighbor?
2027-04-04.observation: I have heard many people use this passage to excuse many things. Some call this a plea to self-care and others use this verse to say we should change our definition of the word “love.” In the Gospel of Luke, someone asks Jesus who a “neighbor” is and how to receive such a neighbor. Jesus turns the whole conversation around by sharing the parable of the Good Samaritan. In this parable, Jesus shares that the point is not to go looking to find a neighbor. We should go into the world looking to be a neighbor. The point of the verse above is that our natural tendency is to take care of our basic needs without thought. The goal is to love other people without thought of what is in it for us. This can be difficult because there are broken people who will use the hospitality of others. This is why we must also work to develop healthy boundaries so empathy does not become toxic. However, we will be much better off if we think first on how we can help others and not just on how we can receive.
2027-04-04.application: Walk through the day with your eyes open looking for someone to help today.
2027-04-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being so kind to us in so many ways.

2027-04-05.title: Let Him In
2027-04-05.verse: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those who are sent to you! How often I have longed to gather your children together as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you would have none of it!
2027-04-05.observation: When my girls were little, I was nervous about door locks. As little children, they would play and experiment with everything. That’s a good thing. It’s wonderful to watch kids explore their environment. However, they do not always know how to undo something. I was always a little nervous they would lock themselves in a room and not be able to let me in. There were a few times when they did this and I had to talk them through how to unlock the door. The main thing was to keep them calm as they felt their fear rising. In this passage, I hear the pain of God saying He has been trying to teach the people how to let Him in. Many times we lock God out of our hearts without a big reason. It could be we were just busy with life. The bottom line is, never let the pressures or fears of life stop you from listening to the voice of God as He continues to tell us how to let Him back in.
2027-04-05.application: Is God asking you to let Him into your life a little more? (Hint- He is)
2027-04-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for wanting to be near us in all things.

2027-04-06.title: Stay Ready
2027-04-06.verse: Therefore you also must be ready because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.
2027-04-06.observation: In this passage, Jesus is giving His disciples a graphic warning of the judgment that is coming. In modern times, many have been perplexed over these prophecies. The question is whether His prophecies were for the days leading up to the destruction of the Temple in AD 70 or whether they still predict a future event. While I land in the camp that says this is mostly about AD 70, it is possible some of it has to do with events yet to come. Many times prophecy can speak to both near and far futures. The only way we know is after it happens. Then, we realize God knew what He was doing the whole time. The point of Jesus’ command in the passage above is, no matter when it all happens, stay ready. We should never live as though there is nothing coming. Days will get dark, but there will also be days full of light. One day our King will come and set all things right. So, stay ready for both. Live with your eyes open and realize no matter what comes, the King has already won. We walk into victory every day.
2027-04-06.application: Live ready to walk in new victory every day, no matter what it looks like.
2027-04-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through everything.

2027-04-07.title: Be Proud of Who God Has Made You To Be
2027-04-07.verse: so I was afraid, and I went and hid your talent in the ground. See, you have what is yours.’
2027-04-07.observation: Abraham Lincoln said, “Whatever you are, be a good one.” Martin Luther King, Jr. echoed this statement when he was once talking about being the best you can be, whoever that may be. He said there should be a plaque outside your door that says, “Here be the best street sweeper in the entire world.” The point is whoever you are wherever you are, always be the best God-honoring version of who you are. In this passage, the one who had received the least was also the most foolish. He did not honor what the Lord gave him and suffered the consequences. He said he was afraid to lose the money so he hid it. I can imagine that the master would have had more mercy over someone who did the best he could and came up empty rather than on someone who did nothing and also came up empty. I have often said I want to be the hardest-working “one bag” guy you’ve ever met. One day when I get to Heaven, my bag is going to be ripped, stained, burned, and torn. But, I hope to have one more bag ready to give my King. Let those with ten and those with five gain their increases. I’m focused on doubling my one bag with honor.
2027-04-07.application: Take what God has put in your hand to do the best you can with it today.
2027-04-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for trusting us with what You have given us today.

2027-04-08.title: How Great Is the Mercy of Our King
2027-04-08.verse: Jesus said to him, “I tell you the truth, on this night, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.
2027-04-08.observation: Think about it. Earlier in the chapter, Jesus says He knows Judas will betray Him. Now, Jesus reveals that Peter will deny Him as well multiple times. Jesus is surrounded by people who are supposed to love Him, fight for Him, die for Him, and carry on the mission of spreading the Gospel. These are the men who He has poured His life into for the past three years. Now, when He needs them the most, they will deny Him and be scattered. Yet, they are all welcome at His table. The King has endless mercy and endless goodness. He offers forgiveness when we fail and fall. Both Judas and Peter failed Jesus in spectacular ways. One returned to Jesus and one did not. Let’s resolve to always be the ones to return to Jesus. He will welcome us with open arms.
2027-04-08.application: Is there an area you have isolated yourself from God due to failure? Bring it to Him today.
2027-04-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always welcoming us to Your table.

2027-04-09.title: All According to Plan
2027-04-09.verse: At about three o’clock Jesus shouted with a loud voice, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” that is,
2027-04-09.observation: Two things can be true at the same time. When Jesus quoted this verse, He was in agony and fulfilling the plan of God. This quote is from Psalm 22. This is a psalm about someone going through difficulty, but the Lord rescuing Him out of it all. Therefore, Jesus is not saying His Father had forsaken Him in the literal sense. He is quoting the first verse of this psalm to both announce His agony but also proclaim that everything is going according to plan. There is an unhelpful and untrue thought that everything goes well when we are in the “will of God.” Actually, the will of God leads us through many different ups and downs. Our goal is to stay true to the course and watch what God does through it all.
2027-04-09.application: Don’t get off the path. All is going according to plan.
2027-04-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for watching over our lives.

2027-04-10.title: A Never Ending Purpose
2027-04-10.verse: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit,
2027-04-10.observation: We have a never-ending purpose. This purpose given to us by Jesus does not fade with time, failure, or success. We must always be about the Father’s business of being ambassadors of reconciliation. This purpose does not change and we can all do it. We live to know God and to help Him be known among others. This is what it means to make disciples. A good definition of a disciple is to have all of Christ in all of life. We have an endless supply of purpose, joy, difficulty, and calling. This adventure always has one more twist and one more surprise along the way. We never give up on people, because God never gave up on us. We may get weary, but we keep on. We may experience loss, but we keep on. The King is worthy of nothing less.
2027-04-10.application: Share your faith with someone today.
2027-04-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for making disciples out of us so we can share what we have found with others.

2027-04-11.title: Fear God Above All Else
2027-04-11.verse: And because the midwives feared God, he made households for them.
2027-04-11.observation: When it comes to the ethics of living in this world, we can sometimes become confused over how we interact with the various seasons of life. We live in two kingdoms at once, the kingdom of God and the kingdoms of this world. Our highest law is the kingdom of God. This almost always makes us great citizens in the kingdoms of this world, because we end up obeying the laws of the land by default. However, there will come times when the laws of the land will not agree with the law of God. When this happens, we always obey the LORD. The midwives disobeyed the law of Pharaoh because the higher law of God prevailed. When we choose to obey God rather than men, the LORD will bless us for it. This is usually not easy, but it is holy.
2027-04-11.application: Make sure you obey God above all else.
2027-04-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us into all righteousness.

2027-04-12.title: The LORD Hears You
2027-04-12.verse: God heard their groaning; God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob. God saw the Israelites, and God understood.
2027-04-12.observation: Israel had been in slavery for hundreds of years. We can sometimes think the Lord doesn’t hear us after a weekend of prayer. Can you imagine how alone and forsaken the nation of Israel must have felt? However, they were never alone. God heard them. God remembered them. God saw them. When the time was right, the Lord moved. We do not always know why God’s timetable is what it is. We do not always understand why God waits as long as He does. However, we know the Lord is good and His mercy shines forever. Therefore, we can trust that He never allows us to suffer for no reason. Our job is to be faithful and to trust the Lord in all things.
2027-04-12.application: Are you willing to wait for the Lord?
2027-04-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for seeing us in every struggle.

2027-04-13.title: God Is With Us Even Before The Danger Comes
2027-04-13.verse: But I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go, not even under force. So I will extend my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders that I will do among them, and after that he will release you.
2027-04-13.observation: This is one of the most powerful chapters in the Old Testament. The LORD reveals Himself to Moses and sends Moses on a mission of freedom. One of the most amazing aspects of this story is that God tells Moses in advance that the journey will be difficult. We can sometimes assume that because the Lord is sending us, it will be easy. Surely the Lord will not send us into danger! Not so. Many times, our journey with the Lord will send us straight through difficulty. However, the Lord goes with us and wins the battle before we even arrive. The Lord told Moses that it would be hard, but the Lord will prevail in the end. The same is true for us. Our lives will often be more difficult than we expected, but the Lord always prevails in the end. Our job is to stay faithful, stay close to Him, and take the next step.
2027-04-13.application: The journey will be hard. Your job is not to figure out the end. Your job is the next step.
2027-04-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for knowing the end from the beginning.

2027-04-14.title: God Has Answers
2027-04-14.verse: Moses answered again, “And if they do not believe me or pay attention to me, but say, ‘The Lord has not appeared to you’?” The Lord said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A staff.
2027-04-14.observation: Moses had so many questions. It is impossible to tell if he had innocent questions or if he thought he could somehow convince God that there were too many reasons to choose someone else. However, for every question, the LORD had an answer. Just like Moses, we will often have many questions about our life, our calling, our future, and more. If we are willing to seek the LORD, He will provide the answers we need. This does not mean He will give us the answers we want. Moses asked what to do if the people did not believe him. God responded, but not in a way Moses may have expected. The same goes for us. We must be careful not to preload our expected answers. Ask God, then study His Word. Let the truth of God’s Word lead us wherever it will.
2027-04-14.application: Don’t just let questions linger. Take them to God by studying His Word and watch what He does.
2027-04-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being willing to give answers to all our endless questions.

2027-04-16.title: Worse Before It Gets Better
2027-04-16.verse: That same day Pharaoh commanded the slave masters and foremen who were over the people: “You must no longer give straw to the people for making bricks as before. Let them go and collect straw for themselves. But you must require of them the same quota of bricks that they were making before. Do not reduce it, for they are slackers. That is why they are crying, ‘Let us go sacrifice to our God.’ Make the work harder for the men so they will keep at it and pay no attention to lying words!
2027-04-16.observation: I have heard of people before who swallowed something poisonous. They go to the emergency room and the doctors will give them medicine intended to cause their body to expel anything in their digestive tract. The goal is to make them better, but it will get worse before it gets better. There are many examples of this in life, and we see this happening in today’s text. God has appointed that it is time for the nation of Israel to be free. However, this does not mean things will immediately get better. Sometimes, breaking free means it will get worse first. If we do not remember that the LORD is in control, we can become discouraged. However, when we realize that the LORD has promised to work all things for our good, we will not see things getting worse as anything other than the LORD doing what has to be done. Do not let outward, temporary circumstances shake your faith that the LORD is still in control.
2027-04-16.application: Determine to not let any outside circumstances shake your faith in God’s ultimate plan of victory.
2027-04-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being in control when the world looks out of control.

2027-04-17.title: The Battle of Perspective
2027-04-17.verse: When the Lord spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt, he said to him, “I am the Lord. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I am telling you.” But Moses said before the Lord, “Since I speak with difficulty, why should Pharaoh listen to me?
2027-04-17.observation: It would seem that one of the greatest obstacles in the story of Israel’s freedom was Moses getting past his insecurities. He continued to see this battle as a conflict between Pharaoh and himself. In this conflict, it appears as though he assumed he was fighting against Pharaoh all alone. The better perspective was to realize that God was there the whole time. He is never going before Pharaoh alone. Even if Pharaoh said no, that is his problem. Moses is merely the messenger. How many times do we lose perspective in our own lives because we think we have to figure everything out on our own, do everything on our own, and walk through life alone? What would happen if we realized that God is with us in every step, in every conversation, and in control in more ways than we realize? Would it change how we faced every obstacle today?
2027-04-17.application: Think of God as walking beside you today. Does it change the way you engage with your world?
2027-04-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being with us in every moment.

2027-04-18.title: God Has Enemies But No Rivals
2027-04-18.verse: When the fish that were in the Nile died, the Nile began to stink, so that the Egyptians could not drink water from the Nile. There was blood everywhere in the land of Egypt! But the magicians of Egypt did the same by their secret arts, and so Pharaoh’s heart remained hard, and he refused to listen to Moses and Aaron—just as the Lord had predicted. And Pharaoh turned and went into his house. He did not pay any attention to this.
2027-04-18.observation: The magicians thought they were showing their worth by proving they could add to what God was doing. However, an assertion of dominance would have been to overpower the will of God and to remove the plague. This shows that they were not really a threat to God. They could only mimic His greatness. God has many enemies and there will be many foes in our lives that will try to take the place of God in our lives. However, none of them are greater than the Lord and none of them pose any threat to His rule. Therefore, we should never live in fear of the enemies of God. They may be able to do harm, but they can never overpower the Lord. He has no rivals to His Throne. He is King forever.
2027-04-18.application: Live your day with a holy confidence that your Heavenly Father is on the Throne. This does not make us better than anyone else. It makes us servants of Him who is greater than all things.
2027-04-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for reigning supreme forever.

2027-04-19.title: What Have You Done For Me Lately?
2027-04-19.verse: So Moses went out from Pharaoh and prayed to the Lord, and the Lord did as Moses asked—he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. Not one remained! But Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also and did not release the people.
2027-04-19.observation: When my girls were little, it was sometimes frustrating as a dad how quickly they would forget things. We would take a day and have so much fun. We would go to the park, go out to eat, and play games late into the night. However, if we did not do the same thing the next day, they would say they never get to do anything fun. It would be frustrating that their appreciation seemed to reset every evening. Then, one day I noticed myself doing the exact same thing to the Lord. I would experience the greatness of God one day and wake up the next day wondering why God only blessed others. We can see the same thing happening to Pharaoh in this passage. When God’s greatness was being displayed in front of him, Pharaoh recognized who God was. However, as soon as the moment had passed, he questioned God’s greatness. May it never be said of us. May we always remember God’s greatness and realize God does not have to prove Himself to us over and over again.
2027-04-19.application: Do you sometimes forget God’s goodness from day to day? List five things God has done within the past week that you need to be sure not to forget.
2027-04-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being patient with us.

2027-04-20.title: Learning From the Stubbornness of Others
2027-04-20.verse: Those of Pharaoh’s servants who feared the Lord’s message hurried to bring their servants and livestock into the houses, but those who did not take the Lord’s message seriously left their servants and their cattle in the field.
2027-04-20.observation: I heard someone once say, “Everyone has value, even if it is to be a bad example.” This is true. There are some things we can only learn by experiencing them for ourselves. However, there are many things we can learn by watching the successes and faithfulness of others. In today’s passage, the officials of Pharaoh had learned from the past and the difficulty they and others around them had experienced. Therefore, they listened to the Word of God and took precautions. Hopefully, those who watched the mercy they received learned from their example and followed their lead the next time. What can you learn from others today? What can others learn from you? How can you be an example of grace to someone today?
2027-04-20.application: Think about the influences in your life right now. What can you learn about God through their influence?
2027-04-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for constantly leading us into more and more freedom.

2027-04-21.title: Trying to Compromise With God
2027-04-21.verse: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and said, “Go, serve the Lord—only your flocks and herds will be detained. Even your families may go with you.” But Moses said, “Will you also provide us with sacrifices and burnt offerings that we may present them to the Lord our God?
2027-04-21.observation: I heard someone once define compromise as halfway happy. I have also heard people talk about their relationship with God as something that sounds like a business deal where they are trying to find a compromise. They want to honor God, but they also want God to honor some things they want, too. That is not how it works. Imagine you were in the ocean drowning and a stranger came to save you. Would you try to negotiate how they threw you a life preserver, what they came there in, and how they went about saving you? No. I imagine you would tell them you were willing to do anything for salvation. Since they were a stranger, all you could do is hope they would be good. Now, imagine it was your best friend. You would simply let them do what needed to be done, because you completely trusted they were out for your best interest. That is the way we should see our salvation. There is no need for compromise. We simply trust. The One who loves us the most is the one who is reaching out to save us.
2027-04-21.application: Are you trying to hold on to something and hoping God will compromise His Word to make you happy? Is it time to let go and trust Him?
2027-04-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being trustworthy.

2027-04-22.title: The LORD Shows Us the Ditch
2027-04-22.verse: Moses said, “This is what the Lord has said: ‘About midnight I will go throughout Egypt, and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt will die, from the firstborn son of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, to the firstborn son of the slave girl who is at her hand mill, and all the firstborn of the cattle.
2027-04-22.observation: I was once riding with some friends and the driver kept swerving closer and closer to the ditch. While we were all laughing at her inability to pay attention, we were also becoming increasingly concerned. Finally, the friend in the passenger seat prayed, “Lord, show her the ditch!” Once again, we were all having a good time, but the reality of the danger was real. The passenger was praying the Lord would make her aware of the danger so she would take proper precautions to stay away from it. God continues to show Pharaoh the danger of not obeying, but Pharaoh refuses to pay attention to the consequences of his actions. The consequences become worse and worse, yet Pharaoh continues to move forward blindly. How many times do we need to do this? How different could things have been if Pharaoh had finally realized he was headed for disaster before it was too late?
2027-04-22.application: Pray and ask the Lord to show you any possible “ditches” in your life before you fall into them. If He does, have the courage to make necessary course corrections.
2027-04-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing us what’s wrong in our lives so we can be free.

2027-04-23.title: The LORD is a Promise Keeper
2027-04-23.verse: It was a night of vigil for the Lord to bring them out from the land of Egypt, and so on this night all Israel is to keep the vigil to the Lord for generations to come.
2027-04-23.observation: If someone promises something, we tend to judge the faithfulness of their promise by how quickly they come through. For example, if someone says they will buy you lunch, the assumption is it will be that same day. If they do not buy lunch that day, it is common to assume they were not faithful to keep their word. However, the promise did not have a due date. Therefore, the promise is still good. It is only the timing that is possibly flexible. This is the same with God. When God promises to do something, we tend to judge His faithfulness based on how quickly He does it. However, this is not how it works. God is always doing more than we realize. For example, imagine the person we mentioned above did not buy lunch that day because your favorite restaurant was closed. The next day they bought lunch and did so from your favorite restaurant. Not only would they be considered faithful, they would be considered thoughtful, too. That’s the same with the LORD. He does above and beyond all we think.
2027-04-23.application: Where do you need to trust God’s faithfulness over your idea of timing today?
2027-04-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being better than we realize.

2027-04-24.title: The LORD Guides Our Steps
2027-04-24.verse: Now the Lord was going before them by day in a pillar of cloud to lead them in the way, and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, so that they could travel day or night. He did not remove the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night from before the people.
2027-04-24.observation: The nation of Israel had been in bondage for over 400 years. Likely, none of them knew the way back to the Promised Land of their ancestors. Perhaps they had heard of the stories, but it is possible those stories had fallen into legends more than directions. The LORD did not expect them to figure it out on their own. He guided them along the way. They had to do the moving. They had to keep up. They had to pack up every night and set out every morning, but the LORD directed their steps. This is a principle from God’s Word that we must understand. The LORD will do the impossible, but He expects us to do the possible. When we realize that the LORD is with us and guides us, then we begin to understand what fellowship with the LORD looks like as He guides us along life’s pathways.
2027-04-24.application: How is the Lord guiding your life through daily faithfulness?
2027-04-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us through Your Word, Your community, and the continual fellowship of the Holy Spirit.

2027-04-25.title: Hardship Leading to Victory
2027-04-25.verse: Tell the Israelites that they must turn and camp before Pi Hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea; you are to camp by the sea before Baal Zephon opposite it. Pharaoh will think regarding the Israelites, ‘They are wandering around confused in the land—the desert has closed in on them.’ I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will chase after them. I will gain honor because of Pharaoh and because of all his army, and the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord.” So this is what they did.
2027-04-25.observation: When the nation of Israel was freed, it might have seemed as though it was going to be smooth sailing after that. However, walking with God is like a roller coaster. Life is full of ups and downs. If we are not careful, we can feel as though God is for us when things are up and God is against us when things are down. However, when we ride a roller coaster, we don’t think the ride is broken when it goes down and it is working when it is going up. We realize the ups and downs are all part of the complete experience. The nation of Israel was about to experience a moment that would seem as though God was against them. This was not true. They were going to experience a difficult moment so that God could show His glory and they could experience victory. What would it look like for us to see the ups and downs of life as all part of the experience? How would we see every moment if we realized that God never changes His mind about us? He always loves us, and the experiences of life do not show us how God feels about us. He loves us in the good days and the bad days. Therefore, when we see bad days, we realize there is a future victory on the way.
2027-04-25.application: How can you reframe your current experience through the unchanging love of God?
2027-04-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being good and doing more than we can see.

2027-04-26.title: Necessary Unnecessary Hardships
2027-04-26.verse: He said, “If you will diligently obey the Lord your God, and do what is right in his sight, and pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, then all the diseases that I brought on the Egyptians I will not bring on you, for I, the Lord, am your healer.
2027-04-26.observation: When I was a teenager, I played basketball for the junior high team. As a team, we were good and won many of our games. However, the coach noticed our free throw percentage was not good. Then, one day we lost a game that could have been won if we had made all our free throws. At the next practice, the coach would not let anyone go home until we had each made 100 free throws. Some might have considered it an unnecessary punishment for our loss, and it was. Making those free throws would not take back the loss and only seemed to make us all frustrated. However, the coach knew something we did not. The only way to get better at free throws is to practice them with good form. Therefore, what seemed unnecessary was more necessary than we realized. Afterward, the coach told us to keep practicing our free throws. If we were careful to keep it up, we would not have to add them to our practices anymore. This is what God is saying in today’s passage. If the nation of Israel is careful to do what God says, they will not have to experience the hardships that are not necessary. But, if they refuse to listen, they will experience how unnecessary hardships become a necessary part of their sanctification. How many times could we look at experiences in our lives and honestly say this was what happened to us? We experience hardships that would have been unnecessary if we had only paid attention to God’s Word.
2027-04-26.application: Are you currently experiencing hardships that have become necessary due to bad decisions? What if you reframed them as learning experiences?
2027-04-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always guiding us along the way.

2027-04-27.title: Our Memory Will Lie to Us
2027-04-27.verse: The Israelites said to them, “If only we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the pots of meat, when we ate bread to the full, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger!
2027-04-27.observation: As a pastor, I have to be very careful about telling stories at funerals. I have learned the hard way that many people will remember the same story very differently. To one person, a story may bring comfort and it can bring great pain to someone else. The truth is that our memories will lie to us. They will make some moments bigger than they are or dull the hard edges of other moments. In the text today, the people forgot about the cruel life of slavery and only remembered the free food. They had forgotten that none of it was free. The cost was their freedom. At that moment, they did not remember the Lord’s goodness. All they saw was their pain. This is why we need to trust the Lord and have people we trust in our lives. We do not always see things clearly. Therefore, we must trust that today is better than we realize, and yesterday is not where we need to be. All is in God’s hands, and He is always good.
2027-04-27.application: Is there any area where you need to stop looking back and start looking forward?
2027-04-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us in spite of ourselves.

2027-04-28.title: Be A Helper
2027-04-28.verse: When the hands of Moses became heavy, they took a stone and put it under him, and Aaron and Hur held up his hands, one on one side and one on the other, and so his hands were steady until the sun went down. So Joshua destroyed Amalek and his army with the sword.
2027-04-28.observation: I know many people who have talked about this story. It is a powerful example of how God uses us to help one another. However, many people talk about this story from the point of view of Moses. They talk about how important it is to have people come alongside you through the seasons of life. This is true, but it is also important to be the person who is coming alongside others. We should all hope to be Aaron and Hur, not just Moses. The true heroes of the story (other than God) are the ones who were willing to serve. Aaron and Hur were God’s vessels to Moses. They were his miracle. What a beautiful thing it is to be a miracle with skin on it for others!
2027-04-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the chance to be Your hands and feet.

2027-04-29.title: Teamwork Is a Force Multiplier
2027-04-29.verse: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “What you are doing is not good! You will surely wear out, both you and these people who are with you, for this is too heavy a burden for you; you are not able to do it by yourself.
2027-04-29.observation: Today’s passage is part of a popular chapter in leadership and management circles. Jethro’s advice to Moses is a powerful example of how organizational leadership is supposed to work. Everyone is part of something bigger than themselves. They have authority and are under authority. This creates a system of checks and balances. However, what is often missed is the miracle of limitations. If Moses had not been limited in his ability to help everyone, there would have never been the opportunity for all these other leaders to serve. Many times we see our limitations as a liability, but it is not always so simple. Sometimes, God allows us to be limited to provide opportunities for us to be part of a team. We cannot do it all by ourselves. We are not supposed to be. We were made for community. When we work together, we are able to do more than we could ever do alone.
2027-04-29.application: How can you help someone else fulfill what God is calling them to do? Who do you need to bring alongside you?
2027-04-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us all gifts, talents, abilities and opportunities to make a difference.
